courses.title: Protective Emergency Casualty Care (PECC)
courses.description: Executive protection and personal security professionals must be prepared to respond decisively when medical emergencies occur — whether managing traumatic injury, sudden cardiac arrest, severe allergic reactions, or opioid overdose. PECC delivers the critical medical skills protection professionals need to keep principals and teammates alive.

courses.title: NV Armed Security Officer Certification
courses.description: This two-day NASOC program exceeds Nevada's required course content and qualification standards for security firearms training. PFC's brand and reputation depend on graduating students who are among the most capable armed security officers in the state.

courses.title: Handgun Optics Skills Tactics
courses.description: Handgun Optics Skills & Tactics (HOST) develops miniaturized red dot sight skills for the defensive handgun practitioner, allowing them to deploy this revolutionary technology with competence and confidence. Students leave with the ability to effectively run optics-equipped handguns in defensive and protective scenarios.

courses.title: Protective Security Operations Certification
courses.description: Protective Security Operations Certification (PSOC) is designed exclusively for private security, Federal Government, DoD, and law enforcement professionals interested in learning modern methods for executive protection and personal security of high-value clients. This comprehensive certification covers advance work, threat assessment, principal movement, and protective team operations.

courses.title: Protective Pistol Skills
courses.description: Protective Pistol Skills (PPS) is PFC's 2-day weapons-centric certification that is entirely range-based, covering combative concealed handgun skills and tactics as they apply to third-person principal defense, principal cover, and protective movement.

courses.title: Covert Operations & Protective Surveillance
courses.description: Modern protective operations often require judgment, discretion, and unique skills — particularly the ability to perform surveillance in support of the principal's safety. COPS trains security personnel in covert protective surveillance and low-visibility operations essential for modern protective work.

courses.title: Protective Driving Operations Certification (PDOC)
courses.description: Proper usage of motor vehicles is a critical factor in executive driving and protective security operations, where safe and proper conduct can mean the difference between a satisfied client and a deadly incident. PDOC provides comprehensive training in protective driving techniques, route planning, and vehicle-based threat response.
